title: Gorgonzola Pasta Bake
description: A keto version of the classic pasta bake, using hearty Croatian pasta and a rich gorgonzola sauce.
instructions: Cook the Croatian pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, combine the gorgonzola cheese, heavy cream, and garlic. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Stir in the cooked pasta, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
